summary: Regression test of the renderFamilyTree() refactor. Backend GET /api/tree-data: 5/5 pytest pass (shape, root=Ludwig w/ Aniela + 9 children, valid refs, authed dates, admin add-person reflected + cleanup). Frontend: home tree renders (9 children, Aniela inline, 23 SVG paths), child click re-centers + URL /tree/<id> + parents row + Viewing label; Back/Root/browser-back work; /tree/<Test Person> shows Anna First inline and Maria Second on separate dashed row with Adam/Bertram/Cecilia; wed-date tooltips 'm. 1942'/'m. 1956' on hover; logged-in person-tooltip shows dates; focus click opens shadcn PersonDetailModal with back button; /demo renders from static data, re-centers, ft-detail-window opens/closes; newly added person appears after navigating /admin -> /. No createRoot/unmount console errors. Found 1 React setState-in-render warning and 1 minor connector overshoot.

minor.issue: spouse wed_date/end_date are returned to anonymous users (people dates are hidden but marriage dates are not). Confirm intended; tooltip 'm. 1942' visible while signed out.

ui_bugs.issue: Dashed line overshoots ~20px past the right edge of a child's extra spouse box (e.g. Maria Second in root view and /demo). RCA: the ref div for extras (FamilyTreeView.jsx ~line 371) is a full-width block inside flex-col, so rect().cx is the wrapper's centre (862px) not the node's (753px); line M573,693 L862.5,693 vs node right edge 843. Fix: add className="w-fit" to that wrapper div (as done for partner rows).

integration_issues.issue: Console error: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (TreePage)'. RCA: TreePage.handleModalBack calls navigate() inside the setHistory updater function, which React runs during render. Fix: read history from state, compute prev, call setHistory(h=>h.slice(0,-1)) and navigate() outside the updater (as goBack does).

issues: Two close 'X' icons appear at the top-right (shadcn DialogContent default close + custom close), slightly offset - verify and hide one
Static sample includes test records 'Test Person', 'Anna First', 'Maria Second' copied from DB - consider replacing with realistic sample names
